note: Original content, MIT with this repo. The executable half of the schema.

playbooks.name: THE UNDERSTUDY
playbooks.about: You have been second in line so long it has become a personality. You know everyone's part better than they do. Nobody has asked you to step forward.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: One chance in front of people who matter
To be needed rather than wanted
For someone to notice without being told

questions.question: what am i hiding?
options: I put myself here on purpose

questions.question: what are my people like?
options: They rely on me and say so
They rely on me and never say so

playbooks.name: THE RETURNEE
playbooks.about: You went away and came back, and the place did not hold your shape. Everyone remembers a version of you that you have outgrown.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: To be met as who I am now

questions.question: at my best i am...
options: Wide-eyed about what others take for granted
Willing to say the unsaid thing

questions.question: at my worst i am...
options: Nostalgic to the point of dishonesty

questions.question: what did i bring back?
options: A silence about why I left

questions.question: what are my people like?
options: They act like I never left
They are proud in a way that stings

playbooks.name: THE FIXER
playbooks.about: Problems arrive at your door pre-chewed. You solve them, and the solving has quietly become the only way you know how to be close to anyone.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: To be asked how I am

questions.question: at my best i am...
options: Resourceful past the point of reason

questions.question: at my worst i am...
options: Solving things nobody asked me to solve

questions.question: what are my people like?
options: They call only when something breaks

playbooks.name: THE TRUE BELIEVER
playbooks.about: You found the thing that explains everything, and it has been very good to you. You have not looked closely at what it costs the people around you.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: To bring one more person in
To be proved right in public
A version of this that is kinder

questions.question: at my best i am...
options: Genuinely certain and warm with it

questions.question: at my worst i am...
options: Excusing what I would condemn elsewhere

questions.question: what is my doubt?
options: The people at the top do not believe it
It has not made me kind
I joined for a person, not the idea

questions.question: what are my people like?
options: They think I have been taken in

playbooks.name: THE GOLDEN ONE
playbooks.about: It came easy and early, and everyone told you so. You have never found out what you are like when something is hard.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: A test I might actually fail
To be liked rather than admired

questions.question: at my best i am...
options: Quick to see a way through

questions.question: what are my people like?
options: They are waiting for the fall

playbooks.name: THE WITNESS
playbooks.about: You see everything and step into nothing. It has kept you safe and it has cost you every relationship you claim to care about.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: To be in it for once
To be told my read was right

questions.question: at my best i am...
options: Unswayed by the mood of a room

questions.question: at my worst i am...
options: Present at a harm I could have stopped

questions.question: what are my people like?
options: They tell me things they tell nobody

playbooks.name: THE PROVIDER
playbooks.about: You carry the weight and you chose to. The people you carry have never been asked whether they wanted to be carried.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: For them to manage without me
Something that is not for anyone else

questions.question: what did it cost?
options: A person I chose not to follow

playbooks.name: THE LATE BLOOMER
playbooks.about: Everyone else did their becoming on schedule. You are doing yours now, in public, at the wrong age, and you refuse to be embarrassed about it.

questions.question: what do i want?
options: To be taken seriously starting now
Not to be a cautionary tale

questions.question: what did i miss?
options: A relationship everyone else had at twenty
A career I was talked out of

questions.question: what are my people like?
options: They did the same and never said
